post.description: Send feedback to the HCTI team about HTML/CSS to Image, its API, or its MCP tools. Report bugs or unexpected rendering results, request features, describe confusing behavior or documentation, and suggest improvements. Include what you tried, what you expected, and what happened. Do not include API keys, credentials, or personal or confidential data. Authentication is optional; authenticated feedback is associated with your organization. Returns a confirmation message and feedback ID.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to capture. Required for URL image requests.

css.description: CSS injected into the loaded URL to override styles on the page.

device_scale.description: Adjusts the pixel ratio used for the screenshot. Minimum: 0.1. Maximum: 3. HTML and template renders default to 2; URL renders default to 1.

full_screen.description: Take a screenshot of the entire screen after scrolling down and back to the top.

max_wait_ms.description: Sets a limit on how long to wait before taking the screenshot when the page continues loading irrelevant content. Minimum: 500. Maximum: 10000 and subject to the account plan limit.

metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata stored with the image.

ms_delay.description: Adds extra time in milliseconds before taking the screenshot so JavaScript can execute. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000.

render_when_ready.description: Waits until the page signals that the screenshot is ready. The image fails if the readiness signal is never sent.

selector.description: A CSS selector for an element in the HTML. We’ll crop the image to this specific element.

viewport_height.description: Sets the height of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

viewport_width.description: Sets the width of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

oneOf.description: Options used when generating a PDF instead of an image. Page dimensions and margins must include supported PDF units; margins must contain either zero or four values; scale must be between 0.1 and 2.

disable_twemoji.description: Set explicitly to false to inject Twemoji into the loaded page. Omitted, null, or true leaves the page's emoji handling unchanged and does not disable the website's own emoji scripts.

dedupe_duration_s.description: Reuse an existing image with identical content if it was created within this many seconds. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 31536000. Availability and maximum effective duration depend on the account plan.

max_render_once.description: Ensure the image is only ever rendered and saved one time. This is an advanced option not applicable to most requests.

oneOf.description: Sets Chrome's preferred color scheme. Valid values: light or dark.

timezone.description: Sets the IANA timezone used by Chrome while rendering. Must be a recognized IANA timezone identifier.

block_consent_banners.description: Attempt to block cookie/consent banners from displaying.

identify_as_hcti.description: Identify the top-level page navigation as an HCTI screenshot request using the X-HCTI-SCREENSHOT header.

items.description: A header encoded as name:value. The first colon separates the name from the value.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include on top-level page navigations to the requested URL's origin and any additional_header_origins. Supports up to 20 headers with names up to 512 ASCII characters and values up to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. For GET and form-encoded requests, repeat this parameter using the format `headers=name:value`.

additional_header_origins.description: Additional exact HTTP or HTTPS origins allowed to receive custom headers. Supports up to 20 unique origins of up to 512 UTF-8 bytes each. Origins must use the format scheme://host[:port] without a path; duplicates are ignored. For GET and form-encoded requests, repeat this parameter for each origin.

include_headers_on_subrequests.description: Include custom headers on subrequests to the requested URL's origin and any additional_header_origins. Defaults to false. Requires at least one header.

viewport_mobile.description: Specifies whether the page uses mobile viewport behavior, including its viewport meta tag.

viewport_landscape.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport is in landscape orientation.

viewport_touch.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport supports touch events.

oneOf.description: Sets the CSS media type used while rendering the page. Valid values: print or screen.

proxy_id.description: Specifies which configured organization proxy to use when rendering.

storage_destination_id.description: Specifies which configured organization storage destination receives the rendered image.

jumbo_max_height.description: Maximum height of the rendered image in jumbo mode. Jumbo rendering consumes additional renders and requires jumbo_max_width. Supply both jumbo dimensions. Each must be greater than 0 and no more than 80000; at least one must exceed 8000; total area cannot exceed 400000000 pixels.

jumbo_max_width.description: Maximum width of the rendered image in jumbo mode. Jumbo rendering consumes additional renders and requires jumbo_max_height. Supply both jumbo dimensions. Each must be greater than 0 and no more than 80000; at least one must exceed 8000; total area cannot exceed 400000000 pixels.

transparent_background.description: Specifies whether the image is rendered with a transparent background.

oneOf.description: Sets the file extension on the URL returned by the image creation request. It does not change the stored source image or restrict later rendering to this format. Valid values: png, jpg, jpeg, webp, or pdf. This parameter is accepted only in POST request bodies.

request_overrides.description: Rules that override browser network requests. The block action blocks requests matching a URL wildcard pattern and/or resource types. When both matchers are supplied, both must match. A request is blocked if any block rule matches. Omitted, null, or an empty array adds no overrides. Requires a paid plan. Accepts a JSON array in JSON requests or a JSON-encoded array string in form requests. Maximum 100 rules and 512 characters per URL pattern. Each block rule requires a nonempty URL pattern or at least one resource type; supplied matchers cannot be empty. Not supported in query strings.

post.description: Create images from shared default_options and variations. Each variation overrides corresponding defaults. Results preserve variation order.

post.summary: Create a batch of templated images
post.description: Create images from one or more templates. Set template_id, optional template_version, and template_values in default_options or each variation. Supplying a template_id in a variation resets its inherited version. Object values merge recursively; variation arrays, scalars and explicit null replace defaults. Identical images reuse existing assets. Results preserve variation order.

css.description: Optional CSS for either image source. With `html`, it styles the supplied markup; with `url`, it is injected after the page loads to override page styles.

device_scale.description: Adjusts the pixel ratio used for the screenshot. Minimum: 0.1. Maximum: 3. HTML and template renders default to 2; URL renders default to 1.

full_screen.description: Take a screenshot of the entire screen after scrolling down and back to the top.

google_fonts.description: Google fonts to load. Separate multiple fonts with a pipe, such as 'Roboto|OpenSans', and set font-family in the CSS to use them.

html.description: HTML to render and take a screenshot of. HTML fragments are rendered in a wrapper document unless a complete HTML document is supplied. Required for HTML image requests.

max_wait_ms.description: Sets a limit on how long to wait before taking the screenshot when the page continues loading irrelevant content. Minimum: 500. Maximum: 10000 and subject to the account plan limit.

metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata stored with the image.

ms_delay.description: Adds extra time in milliseconds before taking the screenshot so JavaScript can execute. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000.

render_when_ready.description: Waits until the page signals that the screenshot is ready. The image fails if the readiness signal is never sent.

selector.description: A CSS selector for an element in the HTML. We’ll crop the image to this specific element.

oneOf.description: Values substituted into the template for this render. Must be a non-empty JSON object. Include the values needed by the template.

url.description: URL to capture for this batch item. After default options and a variation are merged, a non-empty `url` takes precedence over `html`; omit it to render the merged `html` instead.

viewport_height.description: Sets the height of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

viewport_width.description: Sets the width of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

oneOf.description: Options used when generating a PDF instead of an image. Page dimensions and margins must include supported PDF units; margins must contain either zero or four values; scale must be between 0.1 and 2.

disable_twemoji.description: HTML/CSS images use Twemoji by default; set `disable_twemoji: true` to disable it. URL images inject Twemoji only with explicit `disable_twemoji: false`; omitted, null, or true leaves the page's emoji handling unchanged.

dedupe_duration_s.description: Reuse an existing image with identical content if it was created within this many seconds. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 31536000. Availability and maximum effective duration depend on the account plan.

max_render_once.description: Ensure the image is only ever rendered and saved one time. This is an advanced option not applicable to most requests.

oneOf.description: Sets Chrome's preferred color scheme. Valid values: light or dark.

timezone.description: Sets the IANA timezone used by Chrome while rendering. Must be a recognized IANA timezone identifier.

block_consent_banners.description: Attempt to block cookie/consent banners from displaying.

identify_as_hcti.description: Identify the top-level page navigation as an HCTI screenshot request using the X-HCTI-SCREENSHOT header.

Supports up to 20 headers with names up to 512 ASCII characters and values up to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. For GET and form-encoded requests, repeat this parameter using the format `headers=name:value`.

extract_values.description: Whether image options are extracted from page metadata. When disabled, only the configured defaults are used.

template_id.description: ID of the template used to render images.

template_version.description: Template version used to render images. Null means the latest version is used.

template_values_mapping.description: Mappings from page metadata to template fields. Each mapping uses either a meta_key or a fallback.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers sent on top-level page navigations to the source website's origin and any additional_header_origins.

additional_header_origins.description: Additional exact HTTP or HTTPS origins allowed to receive custom headers, in the format scheme://host[:port] without a path.

domain_id.description: Domain identifier used in this configuration's Open Graph image URLs.

enabled.description: Whether the configuration is enabled to serve Open Graph images.

OgConfigOgConfig_Templated.description: An Open Graph configuration that renders a template using extracted page metadata.

css.description: CSS injected into the loaded page to override its styles.

device_scale.description: Adjusts the pixel ratio used for the screenshot. Minimum: 0.1. Maximum: 3. HTML and template renders default to 2; URL renders default to 1.

max_wait_ms.description: Sets a limit on how long to wait before taking the screenshot when the page continues loading irrelevant content. Minimum: 500. Maximum: 10000 and subject to the account plan limit.

ms_delay.description: Adds extra time in milliseconds before taking the screenshot so JavaScript can execute. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000.

render_when_ready.description: Waits until the page signals that the screenshot is ready. The image fails if the readiness signal is never sent.

selector.description: A CSS selector for an element in the HTML. We’ll crop the image to this specific element.

viewport_height.description: Sets the height of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

viewport_width.description: Sets the width of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

disable_twemoji.description: Set explicitly to false to inject Twemoji into the captured URL page. Omitted, null, or true leaves the page's emoji handling unchanged and does not disable the website's own emoji scripts.

oneOf.description: Sets Chrome's preferred color scheme. Valid values: light or dark.

timezone.description: Sets the IANA timezone used by Chrome while rendering. Must be a recognized IANA timezone identifier.

block_consent_banners.description: Attempt to block cookie/consent banners from displaying.

identify_as_hcti.description: Identify the top-level page navigation as an HCTI screenshot request using the X-HCTI-SCREENSHOT header.

headers.description: HTTP headers to include on top-level page navigations to the requested URL's origin and any additional_header_origins. Supports up to 20 headers with names up to 512 ASCII characters and values up to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. For GET and form-encoded requests, repeat this parameter using the format `headers=name:value`.

additional_header_origins.description: Additional exact HTTP or HTTPS origins allowed to receive custom headers. Supports up to 20 unique origins of up to 512 UTF-8 bytes each. Origins must use the format scheme://host[:port] without a path; duplicates are ignored. For GET and form-encoded requests, repeat this parameter for each origin.

include_headers_on_subrequests.description: Include custom headers on subrequests to the requested URL's origin and any additional_header_origins. Defaults to false. Requires at least one header.

viewport_mobile.description: Specifies whether the page uses mobile viewport behavior, including its viewport meta tag.

viewport_landscape.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport is in landscape orientation.

viewport_touch.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport supports touch events.

oneOf.description: Sets the CSS media type used while rendering the page. Valid values: print or screen.

transparent_background.description: Specifies whether the image is rendered with a transparent background.

request_overrides.description: Rules that override browser network requests. The block action blocks requests matching a URL wildcard pattern and/or resource types. When both matchers are supplied, both must match. A request is blocked if any block rule matches. Omitted, null, or an empty array adds no overrides. Requires a paid plan. Set default_options.request_overrides to a JSON array. Maximum 100 rules and 512 characters per URL pattern. Each block rule requires a nonempty URL pattern or at least one resource type; supplied matchers cannot be empty. Not supported in hcti: meta tags.

OgSocialSizeOptimizationMode.description: How images are sized for different social platforms.

template_key.description: Template field path to populate, up to 128 characters.

meta_key.description: Meta tag name or property, such as og:title or twitter:description. Supply this or fallback, not both.

oneOf.description: Use the page's available title or description metadata. Supply this or meta_key, not both.

OgTemplateValueMapping.description: Maps page metadata to a template field. Supply exactly one of meta_key or fallback.

page_height.description: Height of the page, with unit (px, in, cm, mm, pt)

page_width.description: Width of the page, with unit (px, in, cm, mm, pt)

scale.description: Scale of the webpage rendering. Defaults to 1.

margins.description: Margins of the webpage rendering. Defaults to 0. 4 values must be supplied: top, right, bottom, left. Units are px, cm, in, mm, or pt.

total_images.description: Number of images counted in this billing period. For a period still in progress, this is the usage recorded so far.

start.description: Start of the billing period, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

end.description: End of the billing period, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, when available. A future timestamp indicates a period that has not yet ended.

PerBillingPeriodCounter.description: Image usage within a single billing period.

username.description: Configured proxy username, or null when authentication is not configured. An empty string is a valid username. Passwords are never returned.
Proxy username, up to 512 characters. May be empty. Whitespace is preserved.

password.description: Proxy password, up to 484 UTF-8 bytes. Required on create. On update, omitted or null is allowed only with retain_password: true. An empty string is a replacement password. Whitespace is preserved.

retain_password.description: Retain the existing password. Only true retains the password. Omitted, null, or false requires a supplied password, including on updates. Explicit true requires an existing password and unchanged username, and cannot be combined with a supplied password. False requires a password; use an empty string for an empty password, or authentication: null to remove authentication.

ProxyAuthentication.description: Proxy credentials. Username is required. Supply a password or retain the existing password on update. Empty strings and whitespace are preserved exactly.

RequestOverride.description: A browser request override. The action discriminator selects the rule type; currently only block is supported.

url.description: URL wildcard pattern to match, using * for any sequence of characters. When resource_types is also supplied, both matchers must match.

resource_types.description: Resource types to match, supplied as an array of names, such as image, script, xhr, or fetch. Any listed type may match. When url is also supplied, it must match too.

created_at.description: Date and time the image was created, in UTC.

id.description: Unique image ID. Use this value to retrieve the image's full metadata.

url.description: HCTI render URL for this image, or the authenticated store endpoint URL when HCTI storage is disabled.

hcti_storage_disabled.description: Whether rendered files saved here are excluded from HCTI storage and the HCTI CDN, with no public HCTI image URL.

baseResult.description: Describes whether the base image was stored and where it was stored.

oneOf.description: Describes whether the transformed image was stored and where it was stored. Null when no transformation was requested.

html.description: HTML to render for the template. Use Handlebars placeholders for values that will be substituted when an image is rendered. Must be non-empty, contain at least one Handlebars placeholder, and compile as valid Handlebars.

name.description: The name of the template, used to identify it in your account. Maximum: 64 characters.

description.description: An optional description of the template for your reference. Maximum: 1024 characters.

css.description: CSS used to style images rendered from the template. Handlebars expressions are not supported in CSS; put dynamic CSS in the HTML instead.

device_scale.description: Adjusts the pixel ratio used for the screenshot. Minimum: 0.1. Maximum: 3. HTML and template renders default to 2; URL renders default to 1.

google_fonts.description: Google fonts to load. Separate multiple fonts with a pipe, such as 'Roboto|OpenSans', and set font-family in the CSS to use them.

max_wait_ms.description: Sets a limit on how long to wait before taking the screenshot when the page continues loading irrelevant content. Minimum: 500. Maximum: 10000 and subject to the account plan limit.

ms_delay.description: Adds extra time in milliseconds before taking the screenshot so JavaScript can execute. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000.

render_when_ready.description: Waits until the page signals that the screenshot is ready. The image fails if the readiness signal is never sent.

selector.description: A CSS selector for an element in the HTML. We’ll crop the image to this specific element.

viewport_height.description: Sets the height of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

viewport_width.description: Sets the width of Chrome's viewport and disables automatic cropping. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 6000. Both viewport dimensions must be supplied together.

disable_twemoji.description: Twemoji is enabled by default for images rendered from the template. Set true to disable automatic emoji replacement. Omitted, null, or false keeps Twemoji enabled.

oneOf.description: Sets Chrome's preferred color scheme. Valid values: light or dark.

timezone.description: Sets the IANA timezone used by Chrome while rendering. Must be a recognized IANA timezone identifier.

viewport_mobile.description: Specifies whether the page uses mobile viewport behavior, including its viewport meta tag.

viewport_landscape.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport is in landscape orientation.

viewport_touch.description: Specifies whether the emulated viewport supports touch events.

oneOf.description: Sets the CSS media type used while rendering the page. Valid values: print or screen.

proxy_id.description: Specifies which configured organization proxy to use when rendering.

storage_destination_id.description: Specifies which configured organization storage destination receives the rendered image.

jumbo_max_height.description: Maximum height of the rendered image in jumbo mode. Jumbo rendering consumes additional renders and requires jumbo_max_width. Supply both jumbo dimensions. Each must be greater than 0 and no more than 80000; at least one must exceed 8000; total area cannot exceed 400000000 pixels.

jumbo_max_width.description: Maximum width of the rendered image in jumbo mode. Jumbo rendering consumes additional renders and requires jumbo_max_height. Supply both jumbo dimensions. Each must be greater than 0 and no more than 80000; at least one must exceed 8000; total area cannot exceed 400000000 pixels.

transparent_background.description: Specifies whether the image is rendered with a transparent background.

request_overrides.description: Rules that override browser network requests. The block action blocks requests matching a URL wildcard pattern and/or resource types. When both matchers are supplied, both must match. A request is blocked if any block rule matches. Omitted, null, or an empty array adds no overrides. Requires a paid plan. Accepts a JSON array in JSON requests or a JSON-encoded array string in form requests. Maximum 100 rules and 512 characters per URL pattern. Each block rule requires a nonempty URL pattern or at least one resource type; supplied matchers cannot be empty.

mode.description: Whether the template variable is required, ignored, or has a fallback value.

key.description: Variable name or path used in template_values, without Handlebars braces. Preserve its casing and nesting when supplying values.

oneOf.description: Saved fallback JSON value used when the variable is missing and its mode selects fallback behavior. Preserve its JSON value type when supplying an override.

kind_hint.description: Inferred value kind, such as string, boolean, integer, color, object, or collection. Use it to choose an appropriate JSON value; an unknown kind provides no type guidance.

helper_kind.description: Handlebars helper context used during value validation, such as if, unless, with, or each. Interpret this together with mode and kind_hint when preparing template_values.

TemplateVariable.description: A variable discovered in a block template, with its key, requirement mode, inferred value kind, and any fallback or helper context.

TemplateVariableMode.description: How a block-template variable is handled when rendering.

data.description: Recent image counts grouped by hour, day, and month. These are different views of the same usage and should not be added together.

per_billing_period.description: Image totals for available billing periods, ordered by period start from oldest to newest. Billing periods follow the organization's billing schedule rather than calendar months.

UsageDataReturn.description: Image usage for the authenticated organization, grouped by calendar intervals and billing periods.

hour.description: Hourly image counts, with up to 72 recent entries. Keys are ISO 8601 timestamps identifying the start of each hour; values are image counts for that hour.

day.description: Daily image counts, with up to 60 recent entries. Keys are ISO 8601 timestamps identifying the start of each calendar day; values are image counts for that day.

month.description: Monthly image counts, with up to 12 recent entries. Keys are ISO 8601 timestamps identifying the start of each calendar month; values are image counts for that month. Calendar months are separate from billing periods.

UsageTimeSeries.description: Image counts grouped by hour, calendar day, and calendar month. Each object maps an interval's start timestamp to its image count. Intervals without recorded data may be omitted.

basic.description: Basic auth using API ID as username and API Key as password. Example: `Authorization: Basic {base64(api-id:api-key)}`
